paragraphs.text: What is generative engine optimization? GEO is the practice of improving how often, and how accurately, AI assistants mention and cite your business in their generated answers. When someone asks "Which web design company in Kochi is best for small businesses?" or "How do I choose a hospital management software?", AI tools pull together an answer from sources they consider reliable. GEO aims to make your brand one of those sources.
The term was introduced in 2023 by researchers studying how content visibility changes inside AI-generated answers, and it is now a standard part of modern search strategy.

GEO vs SEO is not a replacement story. Traditional SEO helps your pages rank in Google's list of results. GEO helps your brand appear inside AI-written answers, which often summarise several sources and may show only a few citations. Both depend on the same foundations: a crawlable site, helpful content, clear expertise and trust signals.

The difference is in the details. AI systems favour clear, factual statements, consistent entity information, direct answers to questions and evidence that other trusted sources mention you. Our work covers both, so you do not need separate SEO and GEO providers.

Answer engine optimization, often called AEO, focuses on formatting content so that search engines and assistants can extract a direct answer. Our AEO services structure pages with question-based headings, concise 40 to 60 word answers, self-contained sections and FAQ blocks with matching schema. AEO and GEO work together: AEO makes your content easy to quote, and GEO makes your brand worth quoting.

sections.h2: What Our Generative Engine Optimization Services Include

items.title: AI Search Visibility Audit
items.text: An AI search visibility audit tests how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Google's AI features currently describe your business and your competitors for important questions. We record whether you are mentioned, cited, described accurately or missing, and we identify why.

items.title: Google AI Overviews Optimization
items.text: Google AI Overviews optimization improves your chances of being cited in the AI summaries that appear above Google's results. It builds on strong rankings, clear answers, structured data and helpful, original content.

items.title: ChatGPT SEO and Perplexity SEO
items.text: ChatGPT SEO and Perplexity SEO focus on the sources these assistants use when browsing the web: well-indexed pages, clear facts, reviews, listings and mentions on reputable sites. Because each assistant uses different search partners and ranking signals, we test and track each one separately.

items.title: LLM SEO and Entity SEO
items.text: LLM SEO helps large language models understand who you are, what you offer and where you operate. Entity SEO is central to this: consistent company name, address, phone, services, founders and profiles across your website, Google Business Profile, directories, social platforms and knowledge sources.

items.title: Structured Data for AI Search
items.text: Structured data for AI search uses schema markup, such as Organization, LocalBusiness, Service, Person, Product, FAQPage and Review, to describe your business in a machine-readable format. Clean schema reduces confusion and helps systems connect your pages to the right entity.

items.title: Brand Mentions in AI Answers
items.text: Brand mentions in AI answers depend heavily on what other sites say about you. We help you earn genuine mentions through digital PR, industry directories, partner pages, expert contributions, reviews and case studies, never through paid link schemes or fake reviews.

items.title: llms.txt Setup
items.text: llms.txt setup adds a simple file that summarises your site's key pages for AI tools. It is a proposed standard rather than an official requirement, and major search engines have not confirmed using it, so we treat it as a low-cost extra rather than a core tactic.

sections.intro: A GEO content strategy maps the real questions your customers ask AI assistants, then creates or improves pages that answer them clearly and credibly. We focus on:

items.text: Service and location pages with direct answers and specific facts
Comparison and "how to choose" guides that AI tools often draw from
FAQ sections written in natural question language
Original insights, data, process details and case studies that others cannot copy
Clear author information and real expertise signals

outro.text: How to rank in ChatGPT answers comes down to the same principle: be the clearest, most trustworthy and most widely corroborated source on your topic.

sections.h2: How to Measure AI Search Visibility

paragraphs.text: How to measure AI search visibility is still an evolving field, since AI answers vary by user, location and wording. We track a fixed set of priority questions each month across major assistants, recording mentions, citations, accuracy and competitor presence. We combine this with Google Search Console data, referral traffic from AI tools in analytics and branded search trends. You receive a monthly report that shows what changed and why.

Businesses that benefit most are those whose customers research before buying: hospitals and clinics, education providers, software and IT companies, travel and tourism operators, law firms, real estate developers and B2B manufacturers. For these sectors, a single AI recommendation can shape a high-value decision. Our generative engine optimization services start with the questions your buyers actually ask, so effort goes into the answers that influence revenue rather than vanity topics.

items.q: How long before we see results?
items.a: Technical and schema fixes take effect as pages are recrawled, usually within weeks. Content and authority gains build over three to six months. Businesses with an established website, genuine reviews and a clear specialism usually see progress sooner than brand-new sites with little history or few independent mentions online.

items.q: Can you guarantee our brand will appear in ChatGPT?
items.a: No one can guarantee that. AI answers change by user and question. We improve the signals AI systems rely on and track progress honestly.

items.q: Is GEO useful for local businesses?
items.a: Yes. People increasingly ask AI assistants for local recommendations, and accurate Google Business Profile data, reviews and local mentions strongly influence those answers.
